dexcap.input: SLAM, electromagnetic hand mocap, and scene point cloud
dexcap.output: Robot joint demonstrations and visual policy
dexcap.supervision: Human mocap; optional robot rollout correction
dexcap.summary: Combines portable hand capture with retargeting and point-cloud imitation learning.

dexwild.input: Wearable human demonstrations and robot data
dexwild.summary: Combines diverse wearable human interactions with robot demonstrations for in-the-wild generalization.

mano.output: Articulated hand mesh; root placement supplied separately
mano.summary: A compact parametric hand model that provides a common mesh representation for capture and reconstruction.

hamer.summary: Scales transformer capacity and mixed hand annotations for robust monocular hand mesh recovery.

wilor.output: Hand detections and camera-relative MANO meshes
wilor.summary: Combines hand localization and mesh reconstruction in an efficient pipeline for unconstrained images.

wildhands.output: 3D hand pose in the camera frame
wildhands.summary: Studies camera conditioning and training recipes for everyday egocentric hand estimation.

handoccnet.summary: Uses occluded image regions as context for recovering partially hidden hand geometry.

hamba.summary: Uses graph-guided state-space scanning to model joint relationships for hand reconstruction.

egohandicl.supervision: Hand geometry and contextual exemplar supervision
egohandicl.summary: Uses in-context exemplars to improve reconstruction under difficult egocentric interactions.

omnihands.input: Monocular or multiview RGB; image or video
omnihands.output: Interacting hand meshes and relative motion
omnihands.summary: Recovers interacting hands across image, video, and multiview inputs with shared tokenization.

vidihand.output: Metric hand pose sequence; scene scale remains a separate question
vidihand.supervision: Video diffusion prior and hand annotations
vidihand.summary: Adapts a pretrained video diffusion representation for detector-free bimanual motion reconstruction.

ace-ego-hand.supervision: Video diffusion prior and hand annotations
ace-ego-hand.summary: Repurposes video diffusion features to recover occluded and temporarily unseen hands.

esther.summary: Uses stereo geometry and temporal context for metric egocentric hand reconstruction.

eventegohands-plus-plus.summary: Adds instance-aware hand detection to event-based egocentric mesh reconstruction.

hawor.output: World-space hand and camera trajectories; inferred scale
hawor.supervision: Hand supervision; SLAM and learned depth alignment
hawor.summary: Combines hand reconstruction, motion infilling, and egocentric SLAM to recover world-space motion.

mint.output: Camera trajectory; camera- and world-space hands
mint.supervision: Large-scale pipeline pseudo-labels and joint annotations
mint.summary: Jointly estimates camera and hand states before composing world-space hand trajectories.

infinihand.output: MANO states; camera and world-space hand trajectories
infinihand.summary: Uses persistent spatiotemporal memory for streaming joint camera and hand motion estimation.

dyn-hamr.input: Monocular video from a moving camera
dyn-hamr.summary: Optimizes global hand motion using camera tracking and interacting-hand priors.

egoallo.input: Headset SLAM poses and egocentric images
egoallo.output: Scene-frame body pose, height, and hand motion
egoallo.supervision: Conditional body-motion model and image guidance
egoallo.summary: Reconstructs the camera wearer's body and hands in an allocentric scene frame.

umetrack.supervision: Real and synthetic egocentric hand labels
umetrack.summary: Learns a unified multiview, multiframe hand tracker for real-time VR interaction.

egograsp.summary: Combines body and interaction priors to recover open-category world-space hand-object motion.

whole.input: Egocentric RGB video and object templates
whole.supervision: Joint generative motion prior with video guidance
whole.summary: Jointly reconstructs hand-object trajectories to handle occlusion and out-of-sight intervals.

egofound3r.output: Metric world-space hands; predicted contact and distance
egofound3r.summary: Predicts hand geometry and point-wise interaction attributes in one model.

egofun3d.output: Interactive 3D geometry, articulations, and function templates
egofun3d.summary: Models interactive objects with function templates that can be compiled for simulation.

egotac.output: Predicted contact and force; not measured touch
egotac.supervision: Image-tactile pairs with measured force and contact
egotac.summary: Learns tactile priors from paired data and predicts contact and force from vision.

touchsight.input: Bare-hand or gloved egocentric RGB video
touchsight.supervision: Pressure-glove measurements and generated visual augmentation
touchsight.summary: Uses glove supervision and visual augmentation to predict dense force for bare-hand video.

dexmv.input: Human manipulation video; recovered hand and object poses
dexmv.summary: Translates reconstructed human hand-object motion into dexterous robot demonstrations.

hop.output: Retargeted sensorimotor trajectories and manipulation prior
hop.supervision: Video-based trajectory reconstruction; downstream RL or BC
hop.summary: Pretrains a manipulation prior on hand-object trajectories extracted from human video.

egoengine.output: Robot-view observations and executable action trajectories
egoengine.summary: Bridges visual and action gaps by synthesizing robot observations and feasible trajectories.

egoaero.summary: Learns dexterous manipulation from one RGB-D demonstration without pre-scanned object assets.

huro.summary: Robotizes diverse human videos to supply aligned visual and action supervision for VLAs.

ego2robot.input: Egocentric human video and motion annotations
ego2robot.output: Retargeted robot actions and synthesized robot views
ego2robot.summary: Converts human demonstrations into robot-format training data across multiple morphologies.

vividex.summary: Refines noisy video trajectories in simulation before distilling a deployable visual policy.

dex-x.summary: Uses simulation to add tactile supervision missing from human video and transfers the resulting policy.

egomimic.input: Aria human video and 3D hand tracks; robot demonstrations
egomimic.summary: Aligns egocentric human demonstrations with robot data in a shared imitation-learning framework.

egobridge.summary: Aligns human and robot policy features while preserving action-relevant information.

egowild2dex.input: In-the-wild egocentric video and robot data
egowild2dex.supervision: Geometric view alignment and human-robot co-training
egowild2dex.summary: Aligns unstable human views and motions with robot observations and actions.

motiontrans.input: Human VR demonstrations and robot tasks
motiontrans.summary: Studies motion-level skill transfer from VR human data through shared multi-task training.

egovla.input: Egocentric human video; limited robot demonstrations
egovla.summary: Pretrains on human wrist and hand actions before retargeting and robot adaptation.

being-h05.input: Human interaction traces and heterogeneous robot data
being-h05.supervision: Unified action-space pretraining and robot adaptation
being-h05.summary: Uses a human-centric action interface to share motion knowledge across robot embodiments.

egoscale.input: Action-labeled egocentric human video; aligned robot data
egoscale.supervision: Human pretraining and aligned human-robot mid-training
egoscale.summary: Studies how large-scale human demonstrations transfer to fine-grained dexterous robot control.

ironmind.input: Egocentric video and heterogeneous robot trajectories
ironmind.summary: Uses camera-space action alignment to reduce reliance on explicit whole-body retargeting.

egosteer.input: Curated egocentric video; robot data and corrections
egosteer.summary: Combines an egocentric data pipeline with robot grounding and correction for steerable policies.

metis.supervision: Unified action space and motion-aware dynamics
metis.summary: Integrates multi-source egocentric data and motion-aware supervision for dexterous control.

being-h0.input: Human video, mocap, and VR data; robot adaptation
being-h0.supervision: Physical instruction tuning and robot post-training
being-h0.summary: Builds motion-based instruction supervision from heterogeneous human capture sources.

videodex.input: Internet human videos and downstream robot data
videodex.supervision: Visual, action, and physical video priors
videodex.summary: Extracts complementary priors from human videos to guide dexterous robot learning.

egozero.supervision: Human demonstrations; no robot training data
egozero.summary: Learns transferable manipulation policies from smart-glasses demonstrations without robot training data.

humanego.summary: Transfers human demonstrations using an entity-level representation of hand-object interaction.

egohumanoid.input: Wearable human motion and limited humanoid data
egohumanoid.supervision: View and action alignment; human-robot co-training
egohumanoid.summary: Aligns egocentric human demonstrations with humanoid control for mobile manipulation.

dexroam.input: VR headset and head stereo capture; robot data
dexroam.summary: Preserves coordinated whole-body motion during human-to-robot demonstration transfer.

egohumanoid-v2.supervision: Kinematic correction and dynamics-aware action refinement
egohumanoid-v2.summary: Transfers coordinated whole-body skills through coarse-to-fine action and visual alignment.

emma.input: Human mobile manipulation and static robot demonstrations
emma.summary: Combines human mobility data with static robot demonstrations to learn mobile manipulation.

dexvip.supervision: Video-derived hand pose prior for RL
dexvip.summary: Uses human grasp poses from unconstrained video as a prior for dexterous grasp learning.

r3m.output: Frozen visual representation for robot policies
r3m.summary: Pretrains a reusable visual representation from human video for data-efficient robot control.

mimicplay.input: Human play video and limited teleoperated data
mimicplay.output: Latent plans and low-level robot control
mimicplay.summary: Learns high-level plans from human play to guide robot skills over long horizons.

lapa.input: Action-unlabeled video and downstream robot data
lapa.output: Discrete latent actions; adapted robot policy
lapa.supervision: VQ latent-action learning and robot fine-tuning
lapa.summary: Learns latent action tokens from videos before grounding them in robot controls.

univla.output: Task-centric latent actions and robot controls
univla.summary: Uses task-centric latent actions to transfer knowledge across viewpoints and embodiments.

moto.output: Latent motion tokens and robot actions
moto.summary: Models video motion with discrete tokens that bridge pretraining and robot control.

gen2act.input: Language; generated human video; robot observations
gen2act.supervision: Human-video generation priors and robot policy training
gen2act.summary: Conditions manipulation on generated human motion to generalize beyond collected robot tasks.

dexwm.input: Egocentric videos and finger keypoint actions
dexwm.supervision: Human video world modeling and hand consistency
dexwm.summary: Uses fine-grained hand actions from human video to train a dexterous interaction world model.

egowam.input: In-the-wild egocentric video and robot data
egowam.output: Robot actions with predicted world features or 3D flow
egowam.summary: Compares pixel, feature, and 3D-flow prediction targets for human-to-robot transfer.

vip.input: Action-unlabeled Ego4D video; downstream goal image
vip.output: Visual representation and dense goal-conditioned reward
vip.summary: Learns visual rewards from human video without requiring action labels.

vid2robot.input: Human prompt video and current robot observations
vid2robot.summary: Uses cross-attention to infer a task from human video and execute it with a robot.

dex-retargeting.input: Human hand pose or keypoint targets; robot model
dex-retargeting.output: Robot hand joint targets; feasibility must be evaluated downstream
dex-retargeting.supervision: Optimization-based; no training data required for basic retargeting
dex-retargeting.summary: Provides configurable kinematic retargeting from human hand motion to multiple dexterous robot hands.

projectaria-tools.input: Aria recordings and calibration; optional MPS outputs
projectaria-tools.output: Synchronized sensor streams and derived tracking data
projectaria-tools.supervision: Tooling and service outputs; capabilities depend on device and service
projectaria-tools.summary: Supplies readers, calibration, synchronization, visualization, and interfaces for processing Aria recordings.

egolocate.input: Six body IMUs and a monocular body-mounted camera
egolocate.output: Body pose, scene map, and global localization
egolocate.supervision: Inertial mocap and visual SLAM fusion
egolocate.summary: Fuses sparse inertial capture with visual localization to reduce global motion drift.

egoposer.input: Headset pose and intermittent tracked hands
egoposer.output: Full-body pose from sparse headset signals
egoposer.supervision: Supervised body motion; sparse observation modeling
egoposer.summary: Infers full-body motion from sparse head and hand signals while handling missing hand observations.

egoego.output: Estimated head motion and plausible full-body motion
egoego.supervision: Separate video and body-motion datasets; conditional diffusion
egoego.summary: Decomposes egocentric full-body reconstruction into head-motion estimation and body-motion generation.

egoposevr.supervision: Synthetic synchronized RGB-D and headset motion; kinematic optimization
egoposevr.summary: Fuses headset motion with RGB-D observations for temporally coherent full-body reconstruction.

eventego3d-plus-plus.supervision: Synthetic and real mocap-aligned event datasets
eventego3d-plus-plus.summary: Recovers egocentric body motion from event streams under fast motion and challenging illumination.
